name: io.github.punyamsingh/docmost-mcp
title: Docmost (self-hosted)
description: Read, search, create and edit self-hosted Docmost wiki pages in Markdown. No Enterprise API key.

environmentVariables.name: DOCMOST_URL
environmentVariables.description: Base URL of your Docmost, v0.70 or newer, e.g. https://docs.example.com

environmentVariables.name: DOCMOST_EMAIL
environmentVariables.description: Email of the Docmost account to log in with (an account without MFA)
